description.value: Papa John's is a national pizza chain franchise located on Sooke Road in the western Victoria area, serving pizza, breadsticks, and wings. The location offers both delivery and carryout ordering. It sits in a strip-mall unit convenient for cyclists passing through the Colwood corridor.
